commit 1c6801bd2a2e5efef4d49139fc6a2cc3be349fee
Author:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jul 28 23:00:34 2026 +0000
Commit:     geoff@darktrojan.net <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jul 28 23:02:43 2026 +0000

    Bug 2057043 - Reduce noise when vendoring rust. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,ebaginski
    
    Different versions of rust can produce different artifacts when
    vendoring. Some of these files were already accounted for.  We should
    also be ignoring .gitignore and the ephemeral .cargo-ok marker file
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D313630

diff --git a/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py b/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py
index f41af8a9f76..ceec23f6f44 100644
--- a/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py
+++ b/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py
@@ -551,7 +551,7 @@ def cleanup_vendor(command_context):
 
         unlinked = []
         # Remove files from checksum that are in SRC_TAR_EXCLUDE_PATHS
-        for pattern in (".gitattributes", ".gitkeep", ".gitmodules"):
+        for pattern in (".gitattributes", ".gitkeep", ".gitmodules", ".gitignore", ".cargo-ok"):
             for path in package_dir.rglob(pattern):
                 unlinked.append(mozpath.normsep(str(path.relative_to(package_dir))))
title: Bug 2057043 - Reduce noise when vendoring rust. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,ebaginski
